previousContract.meaning: Pins selected player observations, event-reveal chronology and action binding; this version adds one resolved-night checkpoint transferable between pinned engine instances.

source.meaning: Frozen product source for model fixtures only; not a balance or release verdict.

scope.checkpoint: Capture the four-seat solo state graph after one complete headless night and before the next night; include ordered collections, alias identity, private destinies, public game history, report accumulators, policy-information memory, and both gameplay/UI RNG counters.
scope.restore: Restore that in-memory checkpoint into a second engine instance loaded from the same pinned and instrumented product source. Replace only the destination engine state graph and RNG counters; preserve the destination engine's own RNG closures.
scope.nextRound: Call the frozen nextRound function, including its market carry-forward and next-market draw, then stop at an injected boundary immediately before DOM-bound beginRound work.
scope.chance: RNG stream state is checkpointed, but chance support and conditional weights are not enumerated. This fixture does not transform seeded draws into a complete stochastic game tree.
deferred: Every legal decision and complete action profile after restore
Every public reveal and automatic transition between decisions
Complete chance support and exact conditional probabilities
Portable cross-process serialization, canonicalization and equivalence reduction
Terminal utility, feasible policy enumeration, solver and independent full-game review

chanceInventory.knownDependency: Role selection, item/cursed-item deck order, night-rule order, market draws and event order consume the gameplay RNG stream.
Wish draws, AI mark choices, event options and event effects have state-dependent supports and may consume a variable number of draws.
Curse placement, without-replacement deck state, stochastic AI actions and residual bid ties are not represented as exact weighted branches.
Battle randomness and conditional endgame rewards require exact support conditioned on the complete current state.
The separate UI stream is restored for replay fidelity; it must not be treated as strategic chance unless a proven gameplay dependency is found.

proves: The adapter verifies the frozen product commit, Git blob and SHA256 before loading an instrumented copy of the source.
A checkpoint is captured after the pinned playPolicyGame has completed one night, with private destiny, public history, runner accumulators and both RNG stream states.
The checkpoint omits engine closures while preserving object graph aliases and can be restored into an independent pinned engine instance with fresh RNG closures.
The restored state and original state remain mutation-independent.
The original and restored engine call the frozen nextRound function and produce identical round-2 market state and RNG counters before DOM-bound beginRound work.
doesNotProve: The complete legal action tree, chance support or branch probabilities
A resumable full-game runner with every external continuation variable
All public and automatic transitions, all cross-night checkpoints, or cross-process snapshot compatibility
Canonical state equivalence, terminal utility, strategy enumeration or solver correctness
Game balance, six-chain completion, or release eligibility

nextEngineeringDeliverable.name: complete chance support and resumable cross-night transition history
requirements: Enumerate all random branches and exact conditional weights through initialization, event scheduling, auctions, battles, settlement and terminal rewards.
Resume from restored checkpoints with every game-relevant runner variable and policy-information history intact.
Record each sanitized public and automatic transition between decisions, including auction reveal, battle, settlement and night advance.
Prove canonical snapshot equivalence without dropping order, alias, private-destiny or RNG-continuation distinctions.
Define terminal utility and feasible policy/solver scope before any pass claim, then obtain independent review.

gate.blockingReason: V9 restores one in-memory post-night checkpoint into another pinned engine and verifies the next market schedule only. Complete chance, all transitions, resumable runner state, canonicalization, payoff, policy enumeration and independent solver review remain incomplete.
